module.title: Server: Log
module.description:
Log replacement with file and database backend.
Stores entry in file (default: logs/app.log). Also stores entry in database base table log_messages, if enabled.
Supports to log:
- errors - warnings - notices - infos - debug infos
into a log file in these formats:
- PHP serial - JSON serial - Plain text with whitespace
**Features:**
- stores exceptions into log file (serialized) - can send mails to one or more mail receivers
**Call By Environment:** ``` $this->env->getLog()->log( 'warn', '...message...', $this ); ``` where the third argument is the calling object, logged as context.
**Static Call:** ``` Resource_Server_Log::staticLogError( $this->env, '...message...', $this ); ``` where the third argument is the calling object, logged as context.
**Call By Hook:** ``` $payload = [ 'type' => 'error', 'message' => '...message...', ]; $this->env->getCaptain()->callHook( 'Env', 'log', $this, $payload ); ```
**Log Message Types:**
- error - warn - note - info - debug
Each log level can be enabled/disabled and filtered by IPs.
module.log: Make log levels switchable and filterable by IPs.
Extract hook to own hook class.
Add database table and config switch.
module.author: Christian Würker
module.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>log_messages`; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `<%?prefix%>log_messages` ( `messageId` int(11) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `status` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `type` varchar(15) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL, `ip` varchar(63) DEFAULT NULL, `format` varchar(15) NOT NULL, `message` text DEFAULT NULL, `context` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `sessionId` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `userAgent` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `microtimestamp` decimal(20, 6) NOT NULL DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`messageId`), KEY `status` (`status`), KEY `type` (`type`), KEY `ip` (`ip`), KEY `format` (`format`), KEY `sessionId` (`sessionId`), KEY `microtimestamp` (`microtimestamp`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
